sources.entry: Checkmk | Monitoring system for IT infrastructure

summary.one_liner: Checkmk is an IT infrastructure monitoring system offered in a free open-source Raw Edition and a paid Enterprise Edition.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Checkmk as a complete IT monitoring solution available in several editions: a free, 100% open-source Raw Edition and an Enterprise Edition with extra features and professional support billed annually. A demo of the Enterprise Edition is available for non-production testing. It can be installed on Linux servers via DEB and RPM packages, and the Enterprise Edition is also offered as a virtual or physical appliance. The README points to external installation guides and a beginners guide but does not itself describe specific monitoring checks or features. It also explains how to build your own DEB or RPM packages from the source tree using make targets (make -C omd setup, make rpm, make deb). The README states that new pull requests other than pure bugfixes are currently closed, and directs feature contributions to the Checkmk Exchange.
use_cases: install a monitoring system on Linux
evaluate enterprise monitoring with a demo
build custom Checkmk DEB or RPM packages
notable: Free open-source Raw Edition alongside a paid Enterprise Edition
Installable via DEB and RPM packages on Linux
Enterprise Edition also available as a virtual or physical appliance
Can be built from source with make targets for RPM and DEB
caveats: Enterprise Edition features and professional support are paid, billed annually
Only pure bugfix pull requests are currently accepted; new features are closed
Installation guides are external; the README itself gives limited setup detail
